title: Agentic Algorithm Engineering: Improving Shared-Memory Exact Minimum Cuts
abstract: arXiv:2609.07204v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The minimum cut problem for an undirected edge-weighted graph asks us to divide its set of nodes into two blocks while minimizing the weighted sum of the cut edges. Over the last years, we engineered a range of fast algorithms for this problem. Our fastest exact algorithm uses an inexact algorithm to obtain a better bound for the problem, reductions that depend on this bound, improved data structures and parallel contraction routines. It is available in the open-source package VieCut and, on real-world instances, outperformed the previously fastest solvers by a factor of up to 2.5 sequentially and up to 12.9 when run in parallel. translated_title: 智能体算法工程：改进共享内存精确最小割算法
translated_abstract: 无向边加权图的最小割问题要求我们将图的节点集合划分为两个块，同时最小化被切断边的加权和。在过去几年中，我们为该问题设计了一系列快速算法。我们最快的精确算法使用非精确算法来获得该问题的更优界限、依赖该界限的归约方法、改进的数据结构以及并行收缩例程。该算法已在开源软件包 VieCut 中发布，并且在真实世界实例上，串行运行时性能比之前最快的求解器高出最多 2.5 倍，并行运行时高出最多 12.9 倍。我们利用智能体算法工程（agentic algorithm engineering, AAE）改进了该算法，这是我们在本文中提出的一种新方法论，其中自主的大语言模型智能体在现有代码库上运行算法工程循环：它们对运行时间在何处损失形成假设，实现这些假设，并对结果进行基准测试……
tldr: 本文提出“智能体算法工程”（AAE）这一新方法论，让自主大语言模型智能体在现有代码库上执行完整的算法工程循环（形成假设、实现改进、基准测试），从而显著改进了共享内存精确最小割算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces agentic algorithm engineering (AAE), a novel methodology where autonomous large language model agents run the full algorithm engineering cycle on an existing code base, significantly improving shared-memory exact minimum cut algorithms.
